RUS_stalin_apply_rkp_advisor_trait_tier = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 0.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_0_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_0 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 1.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_1_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_1 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_2_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_2 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 3.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_3_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_3 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 4.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_4_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_4 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 5.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_5_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_5 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 6.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_6_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_6 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 7.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_7_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_7 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 8.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_8_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_8 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier < 9.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_9_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_9 = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_10_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_rkp_advisor_trait_tier_10 = yes
		}
	}
}

			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_6_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_psr_advisor_trait_tier_6 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier < 7.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_7_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_psr_advisor_trait_tier_7 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier < 8.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_8_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_psr_advisor_trait_tier_8 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier < 9.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_9_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_psr_advisor_trait_tier_9 = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_psr_advisor_trait_tier_10_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_psr_advisor_trait_tier_10 = yes
		}
	}
}

RUS_stalin_apply_max_advisor_trait_tier = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier < 0.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_0_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_max_advisor_trait_tier_0 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier < 1.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_1_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_max_advisor_trait_tier_1 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier < 2.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_2_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_max_advisor_trait_tier_2 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier < 3.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_3_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_max_advisor_trait_tier_3 = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier < 4.5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_4_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_max_advisor_trait_tier_4 = yes
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_max_advisor_trait_tier_5_active } }
			RUS_stalin_set_max_advisor_trait_tier_5 = yes
		}
	}
}
